Guidance & outlook: We are continuously investing in the capacity, the cost structure and the right channel mix, and we expect these investments to translate into the profitability over the coming quarters in the medium term.
During Q1FY27, the consolidated revenue on a year -on-year basis grew by 26%.
To summarize, our Q1FY27 revenue has been a strong start to the year with record revenue of INR3,161 crores, EBITDA at INR363 crores, PAT at INR183 crores and an EPS of INR5.3 per share.
Growth & demand: On a normalized basis, it grew by 19%, and the revenue stood at INR3,161 crores, driven by strong demand across our key geographies and sustained momentum in our branded portfolio.
EBITDA grew by 21% and the profit after tax on a quarter -on-quarter basis grew by 35%.
Importantly, the volume grew by 11%, demonstrating the sustained consumer preference for our flagship brand across market.
Margins & costs: However, the EBITDA margins moderated from 11% to 11.5% as compared to 12.1% primarily due to ongoing restructuring within the organic foods segment.
Despite the geopolitical uncertainties and trade disruption, this segment EBITDA margin stood at stable 13%, highlighting the strength of our business model and operational execution.
The revenue stood at INR254 crores with EBITDA margin at 4%.
Capex & expansion: Rest of the world, wherein we are strengthening our share, though it's a small market in terms of the basmati consumption, but we are enjoying leadership position in most of the countries, and we are further solidifying our position with the continuous brand investments and the distribution expansion.
